answer: One defence is Globe maker painted globe warrant filed with the compass guild: each painted globe is a year of tide tables in the guild ledger, so a farm must assemble a hundred real globes by hand, and the walnut of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the kernel of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The crystal is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
